_comment: Named groups of astra tools fit for a KIND of project. Non-exclusive: installing one adds its tools and never removes another's, and two templates may overlap freely — swift-ios and legal-pdf both pull the writing tools, and installing one after the other must leave both intact.

swift-ios.description: Swift/iOS app work — the Maharam repos. Xcode both ways (Apple's bridge needs a one-time approval; XcodeBuildMCP is headless), plus simulator and device control.

legal-pdf.description: Legal repos — speedway, hoa, grandparentLegal. PDF to searchable text sidecars, OCR for scans, metadata provenance. NOTE: grandparentLegal wants `git config jsutils.metadataPolicy all` for every-PDF provenance; the default 'pattern' only does meeting-named files.

kicker-dev.description: Working on kicker itself — its own daemon surface plus the mac and Xcode tooling.
